value.rationale: The Brinkmann graph is a canonical extremal four-regular 4-chromatic girth-five graph. The sharp ten-vertex homology support theorem, exact count of natural geometric carriers, two integral orbit bases and full dihedral module reveal previously uncomputed structural topology that rank-only or rational-character formulas do not give. A natural geometric support classification rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
